title: Promotion rejection and complete rollback
content: Promotion needs explicit owner approval and passing model, assistant, permission and reproducibility gates. Compare the expected champion while holding the serialized owner transaction. A rejected candidate leaves the previous release active. Restore the complete earlier model, threshold, prompt, corpus and index release, then replay the saved development fixture; never retune on the external test.
check: Inspect the rejected promotion evidence and, under a separate owner-approved rollback, verify the previous complete release and replay fixture.
